test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On 11 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
If $ means +, # means −, @ means ×, and % means ÷, then what will be the value of the following expression?

32 $ 8 @ 10 # 144 % 16 = ?
solution:
Given: $ means +, # means −, @ means ×, and % means ÷

Explanation:

BODMAS rule

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f22f57d0cf5c493280a0ab6b7dbaea9e3fc5b035c6d410d59c2f476043bd03a8.png] 

By putting values in given equation by BODMAS rule we get

32 + 8 ×10−**144 ÷ 16** 

32 + 8 ×10 − 9

**32 + 80** − 9

**112 - 9**

**103**

Hence,** "Option 4"** is the **correct answer.**
